subject: Troubleshooting - lavaan is splitting data into groups

messages.author: 8e8db99d847a3c5f
messages.subject: Troubleshooting - lavaan is splitting data into groups
parts:
Good day,

I am trying to conduct a hierarchical CFA model in R for to investigate the structural validity of a tool, where:

SCI is the "highest" level (i.e., broad variable),
S1, S2, S3, S4, C1, and C2 are the "middle" level (i.e., domains of SCI variable), and 
dddi_qid_ are specific tool items pertaining to the different domains.

When I try to run the specified model (code included below), I get the following error:

Error in lav_samplestats_step1(Y = Data, wt = wt, ov.names = ov.names, : lavaan ERROR: some categories of variable `dddi_qid710' are empty in group 1; frequencies are [40 40 84 0]

However, I did not specify any groups. My sample size is 372. I am using lavaan version 0.6-9. 

I would appreciate any assistance in figuring out where I might have made an error. 

Many thanks.

__________________________________

R CODE

Model specification:
model1 <- "S1 =~ dddi_qid248 + dddi_qid709 + dddi_qid710 + dddi_qid249 + dddi_qid251 + dddi_qid252 + dddi_qid260 + dddi_qid261 + dddi_qid264
S2 =~ dddi_qid369 + dddi_qid331 + dddi_qid655 + dddi_qid347 + dddi_qid349 + dddi_qid237 + dddi_qid717
S3 =~ dddi_qid304 + dddi_qid303 + dddi_qid299
S4 =~ dddi_qid743 + dddi_qid223 + dddi_qid224 + dddi_qid624 + dddi_qid309 + dddi_qid706 + dddi_qid269
C1 =~ dddi_qid279 + dddi_qid280 + dddi_qid282 + dddi_qid285 + dddi_qid737 + dddi_qid742
C2 =~ dddi_qid705 + dddi_qid744 + dddi_qid747 + dddi_qid679
SCI =~ S1 + S2 + S3 + S4 + C1 + C2
"
cfa.mod1 <- cfa(model1, data = data.dat, ordered = TRUE)
lavaan::summary(cfa.mod1, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: Troubleshooting - lavaan is splitting data into groups
parts:
The part in the error message " are empty in group 1 " ... is automatically generated to adapt to the number of groups. Even with only one group, i.e., no group specified, it will still call this group "group 1".

The default for "missing" is "listwise." Although the total sample size is 372, perhaps the effective sample size after listwise deletion is 164 (40 + 40 + 84 + 0)?

-- Shu Fai
